questions.q: What is the first step of the Grover circuit, applied to n qubits all starting in |0⟩?
options: Apply a Hadamard gate to every qubit (H^⊗n), producing the uniform superposition |s⟩
Immediately apply the oracle before any superposition is created
Measure all qubits to check the initial state
Apply the diffusion operator before the oracle
questions.explain: H^⊗n on |0...0⟩ produces the uniform superposition over all N = 2^n basis states, which is the required starting state for the rotation argument to apply.

questions.q: How is the oracle typically implemented at the gate level for a given marked bit pattern?
options: X gates align the marked pattern to all-1s, a multi-controlled-Z applies the phase flip, then the X gates are undone
By measuring each qubit and checking it classically against the pattern
By applying a Hadamard to every qubit twice in a row
It cannot be built from standard gates and requires a dedicated 'oracle gate' primitive unrelated to Z gates
questions.explain: Flipping qubits that should read 0 in the target pattern reduces the problem to 'all qubits read 1,' which a multi-controlled-Z gate handles directly; undoing the X gates restores the original qubit meanings.

questions.q: What is the gate-level construction of the diffusion operator D, and why does it work?
options: D = H^⊗n (2|0⟩⟨0| − I) H^⊗n; because H^⊗n maps |0...0⟩ to |s⟩, sandwiching the easy 'reflect about |0⟩' operator between Hadamard layers turns it into 'reflect about |s⟩'
D is built entirely from measurement operations with no Hadamards involved
D = (2|0⟩⟨0| − I) alone, with no Hadamard conjugation needed
D requires a completely different gate set from the oracle, sharing no common primitives
questions.explain: Reflecting about |s⟩ directly isn't a convenient primitive, but reflecting about |0⟩ is. Since H^⊗n|0⟩ = |s⟩ and H is self-inverse, conjugating the |0⟩-reflection by Hadamard layers gives exactly the |s⟩-reflection needed.

questions.q: How many oracle calls does one full Grover iteration (oracle + diffusion) require?
options: Exactly one -- the diffusion step uses only the fixed, known |0⟩-target phase flip and Hadamards, not the oracle
Two -- one for the oracle step and one hidden inside the diffusion step
Zero -- the oracle is only called once at the very end, after all iterations
A number that grows with N on every single iteration
questions.explain: The diffusion operator's phase flip targets the fixed |0...0⟩ pattern, which doesn't require knowledge of the marked item, so it needs no oracle call -- only the oracle step itself counts as a query.

questions.q: What is the formal query-complexity result for Grover's algorithm compared to classical unstructured search?
options: O(√N) oracle queries for Grover vs. O(N) classically -- a quadratic speedup
O(log N) oracle queries for Grover vs. O(N) classically
O(N) oracle queries for both, with no speedup at all
O(1) oracle queries for Grover regardless of N
questions.explain: Running t* = ⌊(π/4)√N⌋ iterations, each costing one oracle call, gives a total query count that scales as √N -- the quadratic speedup over the classical O(N) bound.
